premises: Plasma nitriding with NH3:N2 (1:2) at 750 °C for 4 h forms a ~2 µm Ti–N compound layer on TC4
This Ti–N layer significantly increases surface hardness and reduces friction coefficient to ~0.3
The nitrided layer eliminates adhesive wear and provides undetectable wear loss against bearing steel
Hollow cathode discharge configuration enhances nitriding kinetics and layer uniformity
